name: Macadamia and Betel
source:
Berenice is an agent of the human-revolutionary group "The Revolvers'". She is sent on a suicide mission to retrieve a dormant copy of the Royalty Seed, the progenitor of the tyrannical Seeds. 

Post-Apocalyptic SF mega-yuri and renpy-based kinetic novel.

[From [url=https://esbeedle.itch.io/mnb]itch.io[/url]]
